questions.solution_text:
While waiting at the floor (from $12$ to $16$ seconds) the speed stays at $0$, so that stage cannot be used for the departure's acceleration.
From $16$ s ($0$ m/s) to $19$ s ($9$ m/s):
Acceleration $=\dfrac{9-0}{19-16}$
$=\dfrac{9}{3}$
$=3$ m/s²
